title: Integrability of continuous compactly supported functions supported in U for measures finite on compact subsets of U
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and f : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous with compact support and tsupport f ⊆ U. Then f is ν-integrable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ν K < ∞) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Integrable f ν
